contestants.name: You
contestants.motive: Choose who to trust, survive the vote, and build a game you can explain.

contestants.name: Alex Chen
contestants.motive: Run the house from one seat behind it, and never be the name anyone says out loud.
contestants.bio: Strategic mastermind who excels at social manipulation and long-term planning. Always three steps ahead.

contestants.name: Emma Brown
contestants.motive: Test every claim she hears against what she has already seen before acting on it.
contestants.bio: Brilliant mind with a flair for the dramatic. Uses her analytical skills to outthink the competition while keeping everyone guessing.

contestants.name: Jordan Taylor
contestants.motive: Be everyone's second-favourite person, because nobody targets their second favourite.
contestants.bio: Charismatic charmer who can talk anyone into anything. Will do whatever it takes to win.

contestants.name: Casey Wilson
contestants.motive: Keep conversations light, compare what people say, and avoid becoming the obvious target.
contestants.bio: Life of the party with a surprisingly sharp strategic mind. Nobody suspects the fun one.

contestants.name: Riley Johnson
contestants.motive: Turn careful observation into one reliable partnership and a well-timed competition win.
contestants.bio: Analytical genius who calculates every move. May struggle socially but never in puzzles.

contestants.name: Jamie Roberts
contestants.motive: Protect people who treat her honestly while keeping the courage to make her own move.
contestants.bio: Empathetic caregiver who everyone trusts. Not afraid to make bold moves when necessary.

contestants.name: Quinn Martinez
contestants.motive: Be at the centre of every story the house tells, and control how each one is told.
contestants.bio: Fame-seeking manipulator who plays for the cameras. Will create drama for entertainment.
